assay: bulk poly-A RNA-seq, renal cortex, single-end NextSeq 2000 (S2.8.p1)
sample_inclusion: forced treadmill experiment only: Sed, 24 h (pre/post ECT, no training), 1 wk and 2 wk training; n=4 per group (S3.4.p1, FIG6 n=4 per group). The voluntary-wheel experiment had no RNA-seq.
primary_estimand: Effect of 2 wk forced treadmill training vs sedentary on renal cortex gene expression in male mice (S3.4.p1, TAB2)
planned_contrasts: 2 wk vs Sed (TAB1, TAB2: 24 DEGs, 17 up / 7 down)
24 h vs Sed (TAB1: 54 DEGs, 34 up / 20 down)
normalization: DESeq2 RLE; genes with fewer than ten counts across samples removed (S2.9.p1)
paper_method: DESeq2 on HTSeq raw counts of Ensembl protein-coding genes (S2.9.p1)
paper_results: 2wk: 24 DEGs incl. Scnn1a/b/g up, Foxi1, Cyp4a14 up, Mmp13, Cd209a down; 1wk: 0; 24h: 54
